prompts.title: Recent Form: Wins, Draws, Losses
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 scene, 6–10 seconds, reserved lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles. Palette: charcoal #101412 background, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 emphasis, slate #8ca6bf neutral. Editorial variant: kinetic typography and rhythmic emphasis. No statistical axes, no sample claims. Spanish team names 'AFC Bournemouth' and 'Sunderland AFC' appear as stacked headings. Spanish labels 'Victorias', 'Empates', 'Derrotas' slide in from bottom in three beats. Entry 0–2s: team names punch in with lime underline; 2–5s: each Spanish word pulses with a light slate shadow; 5–8s: type splits into a left-right duel, camera drifts upward slowly; 8–10s: words compress into one horizontal line and exit with a fast lime wipe transition. Emphasis is on rhythm and contrast, one focal point at the center of the duel. Statistical variant: grouped count bars with shared zero baseline. Chart occupies upper three quarters, lower quarter subtitles. Horizontal groups for each team: 'Victorias', 'Empates', 'Derrotas'. Bars use {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}. Axis unit 'partidos'. Labels are Spanish. Source and sample annotation at top: 'Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos · {{away.n}} partidos · Fuente: Bzzoiro'. If the sample sizes are unequal, annotate that beside team names. Entry 0–2s: baseline draws in; 2–4s: home bars grow; 4–6s: away bars grow; 6–8s: matching categories compare and the largest visible bar glows lime; 8–10s: values appear above bars, camera pushes in on the focal bar, then a slate transition wipes to next scene. Exit with a clean vertical cut. No hardcoded statistics; all quantitative chart values remain placeholders. Typography uses bold condensed sans for headings and tabular numerals for bars; keep one focal point at the largest bar. The lower quarter yellow subtitle band never moves.
